 "description": "Offers a look at real-world challenges faced in supply chain management. Explores gathering market data on an industry and creating a should cost model. Witnesses the importance of planning ahead on communication, backup plans, and safety stocks. Students are introduced to supply chain KPIs, prepared for negotiations, and participate in negotiations.
